supersession.decision: The 2026-08-01 owner direction authorizes this execution and supersedes the earlier conservative proposal where they conflict; the original audit snapshot remains historical evidence.

canonicalModel.grayscale: Boolean presentation state for every role; never a role, sourceRole, output, document type, filename, or page-count category.
canonicalModel.discovery: registry -> source/case-package.json -> content.html + presentation.css + task-registry.js + referenced assets
canonicalModel.generatedOutputPolicy: Editable copies, role worksheets, print documents, rendered pages, and screenshots are produced temporarily or on demand and are not committed. PDFs are neither stored nor required.

governingRules: Canonical source is the registered case package and its package-controlled files under source/.
Student, Teacher, Answer Key, and Accessible are the only instructional roles.
Grayscale is only a Boolean presentation toggle and never a role, output type, filename, or page-count category.
Generated editable copies, worksheets, PDFs, screenshots, and release documents are not committed.
Prior approved artifacts are recovered through Git and compact release-history records.
The canonical case folder structure is mandatory for Case 04 onward.
schemaChanges: Package schema v2 requires canonical worksheet, presentation, task-registry, source-hash, accessibility, four-role page-count, normal output-name, and release-history fields.
Package schema v2 rejects additional migration-era fields and any fifth role or output.
Registry schema v2 retains operational discovery, status, approval, and history pointers only.
formerArtifactHashes: Each history record contains the former approved complete-document SHA-256 plus four role-output SHA-256 values and a baseline recovery command. Retired legacy presentation snapshots are audit-only entries.

grayscaleRoleProfileReferencesRemoved.note: Legacy filenames remain only inside clearly labeled release-history or cleanup retirement facts.
